fragments.description: Protect ALL explicit user content in P1, regardless of dimension: subjects, lighting, background, framing, colors, materials and exclusions. Prefer one complete P1 paragraph covering the whole request, plus P2 selected-style traits. P3/P4 contain only unrequested compatible additions. Before submission, verify every USER_REQUIRED fact remains represented if P3/P4 are removed. Never demote required content to optional art direction.

priority.description: 1 = required user content (all dimensions), 2 = protected selected-style traits, 3/4 = unrequested compatible additions only. Priority follows necessity, not topic.
